text:
A sample of a radioactive isotope emits 9600 α-particles per second.
After 40 hours the rate of emission has fallen to 600 α-particles per second.
What is the half-life of this isotope?
A
4.0 hours
B
8.0 hours
C
10 hours
D
20 hours
subject: Physics
